description: This file contains debugging extension methods for the CanvasWindowController class, providing test utilities for session key sanitization, JavaScript string literal handling, frame storage, IPv4 parsing, and network checks, conditioned on DEBUG compilation.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: An extension on CanvasWindowController providing test utility methods for debugging purposes.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns JavaScript string literal for optional string.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Generates storage key for frame based on session key.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores and loads a frame using session key.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses IPv4 address string into a tuple of four UInt8 bytes.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IPv4 address tuple belongs to a local network.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if the URL points to a local network based Canvas URL.
